blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-migration-1 (`rename_all = "camelCase"` renames every existing field of the public order JSON) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it
R-migration-2 (`default_currency` is a required key: existing `config.toml` files no longer load) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.evidence:
#[derive(Serialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct OrderResponse {
    pub order_id: i64,
    pub customer_id: i64,
    pub total_cents: i64,
findings.recommendation: Remove `#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]` so the existing keys stay `order_id`, `customer_id` and `total_cents`; only `currency` is added. If camelCase is wanted, ship it as a separate change marked BREAKING, emitting both spellings for the two releases of deprecation that docs/api.md promises.
findings.title: `rename_all = "camelCase"` renames every existing field of the public order JSON

findings.evidence:
/// The currency of orders that do not name one (ISO 4217).
pub default_currency: String,
findings.recommendation: Add `#[serde(default = "...")]` returning "EUR" (the currency used until now) so existing deployments keep starting, and add a test that loads a config without the key. Otherwise mark the change BREAKING and tell operators in the release note to add the key before upgrading.
findings.title: `default_currency` is a required key: existing `config.toml` files no longer load

findings.recommendation: Once R-migration-1 and R-migration-2 are settled, list each remaining breaking change as **BREAKING** with what partners and operators must do. Also add a line for the new `default_currency` configuration key and its default.
findings.title: Release note announces neither the breaking changes nor the new configuration key

findings.evidence: - [x] 1.2 `default_currency` in `src/config.rs` and `config.example.toml`, verified by starting the service on staging
findings.recommendation: Add tests that (a) load a config.toml without `default_currency`, and (b) serialize an `OrderResponse` and assert the exact JSON keys (`order_id`, `customer_id`, `total_cents`, `currency`, `status`), so a rename is caught.
findings.title: No test covers the migration path for old configuration files or API consumers

findings.recommendation: If any crate depends on `orders` as a library, keep `#[deprecated] pub type SalesRow = DailySales;` for one release and note the rename. Otherwise no action is needed.
findings.title: Public `report::SalesRow` and its field `count` renamed with no deprecation
